description: What's armed for the signed-in person: the races they're in and their own events and tour days still to come, their Garmin LiveTrack address and when its last link arrived, whether a Garmin data field is linked and when it was last used, whether they're findable when they start on a race route, and their follow link on livedot.me. Reads only.

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

name: my_live_plan

outputSchema.description: What's armed for race day: races, their own events, Garmins, findable, follow link.

accounts.description: With both accounts: per app, its follow_url and race_routes_findable.

app.description: The account's app: windline or runfast.

devices.description: Linked Garmins (livedot data field): app, linked_at (ISO), last_day (YYYY-MM-DD it last sent, or null).

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

events.description: Their own events armed (Follow live on), still to come: id, type, name, days, from, to, private.

livetrack.description: Their Garmin LiveTrack: { address, last_link_at (ISO or null), status (in words) }, or null when not set up.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

race_routes_findable.description: Live on race routes: findable by everyone when they start on a race's course (false: only people with their link).

races.description: Races they're in, still to come: id, name, date, km, findable, live (tracking on), auto (joined by starting on the course).

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).
